title: Recording: Nobody Sees Me Like You Do, (Just Like) Starting Over, Don’t Be Scared by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The third recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 9 August 1980.

Three tracks were worked on: Ono’s ‘Nobody Sees Me Like You Do’, followed by Lennon’s ‘(Just Like) Starting Over’, and Ono’s ‘Don’t Be Scared’.

Only ‘Starting Over’ appeared on Double Fantasy. ‘Nobody Sees Me Like You Do’ was included on 1981’s Season Of Glass, and ‘Don’t Be Scared’ remained unreleased until 1984’s Milk And Honey.

He had a great three-finger style of playing piano that was really cool and his inversions were very different than what a schooled piano player would play. The very first day that we recorded ‘Starting Over’ he sat down and played ‘Money’, his inversions on that were so strange that it was masterful.
Lee DeCarlo, engineer
Starting Over, Ken Sharp
